synthesis.best_supported_descriptive_contrast: Repeated short parallel verdicts and sustained insider/directive address distinguish the SMZDM reading experience more clearly than the presence of correction syntax or dense explanation alone.
synthesis.shared_patterns: Both articles contain corrective reframing, slogans, conversational moves, and broad inferences from evidence bundles; the Baidu article is a lower-intensity reference, not feature-free.
synthesis.candidate_interaction: The repeated combination of evidence, compact verdict, and direct instruction is a plausible exploratory explanation of the stronger impression. This interaction was noticed after the labels were known and is not tested.
synthesis.surface_vs_content: Cadence and interpersonal stance can be aversive without being wrong. Scope or inferential defects require semantic review and may occur in either article.
synthesis.feature_overlap: Families deliberately overlap at some spans. Their examples are evidence selections, not exhaustive annotations, additive scores, or independent effects.
synthesis.counterfactuals_not_tested: No passage was rewritten, removed, or tested with the reader; improvement and meaning preservation remain unmeasured.

confounders_and_limits: One reader, two articles, known labels, post-hoc feature discovery; cannot infer a general severity scale or causal feature effects.
Different platforms, consumer buyer guidance versus enterprise industry commentary, different article lengths and formats, topics, publication dates, source visibility, and production context.
SMZDM has a publisher AI-generation disclosure and attribution-count claim; neither is the linguistic or quality target, and neither establishes a model or translation process.
Provenance remains unresolved as to translation; untranslated versus translated status is not inferred from fluency, foreign names, or publisher disclosure.
Media references were retained but not inspected. Text-only reading may miss explanatory content carried by media.
Chinese shared arguments, category fragments, nominal predicates, and ordinary ellipsis are valid; no SVO-presence rule was used.
Concrete hardware facts, quantities, version distinctions, purchase restrictions, useful alternatives, attribution, negation, and uncertainty must survive any later intervention.
No previous semantic reviews, root observations, or peer analysis were read. No historical cohort files, final tests, or reader-preference outcomes were consulted.
bounded_next_use: Use the four interpretable hypotheses to seek independent complete-article examples and matched genre/publisher counterexamples under a later explicit protocol. Do not promote a product rule, reward, training target, or intervention efficacy claim from this anchor.

validation.validation_method: Recompute SHA-256 over raw input bytes; reproduce each full text by LF-joining block text; resolve each quoted substring within its named block; assert exact body[start_char:end_char] equality and UTF-8 quote hash before serializing. Repeat the same checks after reading the written JSON.
validation.repository_tests: Not run: only this local research artifact is created; no executable repository behavior is changed.
